newsitem.title: FRANCE: Accor says acquires seven hotels.
newsitem.headline: Accor says acquires seven hotels.

text.p: Hotel group Accor said on Tuesday it signed an agreement last week to acquire seven hotels in the Paris area from French property company Nouveaux Constructeurs.
Accor declined to disclose the terms but said in a statement that the hotels, which have a total of 1,020 rooms, generated combined annual sales of 165 million francs.

"The purchase of these establishments is part of the development strategy of Accor's three-star hotels within the framework of a lease agreement that will not substantially alter the group's debt level," the statement said. A spokeswoman said Accor would lease the property and manage the hotels.
Five of the hotels will become part of Accor's Mercury chain and two will become part of the Novotel chain.
The deal, signed on November 25, is expected to close by the end of the year.
